<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="65.78.5.191" /></noinclude><section begin="par92" />{{GHGmargin-letter|92|e}}
In the segholate forms in the singular and mostly in the dual the suffix is appended to the ground-form ({{GHGheb|text=מַלְכִּי|translate=my king}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַלְכֵּ֫נוּ}}, &c.); on the other hand, before the endings {{GHGheb|text=־ִים}}, {{GHGheb|text=וֹת}} (sometimes also before {{GHGheb|text=־ַ֫ יִם}}) a ''Qames'' regularly occurs,<ref>For the rare exceptions see {{GHGpar|93|l}} and {{GHGpar|97|f}}, note 2.</ref> before which the vowel of the first syllable then becomes vocal {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}} ({{GHGheb|text=מְלָכִים}}, {{GHGheb|text=מְלָכוֹת}}). This {{GHGterm|Qameṣ}} (on which cf. {{GHGpar|84|a|a}}) remains even before the light suffixes, when attached to the plur. masc. ({{GHGheb|text=מְלָכַי}}, {{GHGheb|text=מְלָכֶ֫יךָ}}, &c.). On the other hand, the ''constr. st.'' plur. and dual, regularly, according to ''d'', has the form {{GHGheb|text=מַלְכֵי}}, with grave suffix {{GHGheb|text=מַלְכֵיכֶם}}, &c., {{GHGheb|text=דַּלְתֵי}} from {{GHGheb|text=דְּלָתַ֫יִם|translate=folding-doors}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|92|f}}
(''c'') Before the {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ mobile}} which precedes the suffix {{GHGheb|text=ךָ}} when following a consonant, the ''a''-sound, as a rule, is the only tone-lengthened vowel which remains in the final syllable (being now in an open syllable ''before'' the tone), e.g. {{GHGheb|text=דָּֽמְךָ֫}}, {{GHGheb|text=דְּבָֽרְךָ֫}}, &c. (on the forms with ''ē'' in the second syllable, see {{GHGpar|93|qq}}); but before the grave suffixes {{GHGheb|text=־ְכֶם}} and {{GHGheb|text=־ְכֶן}} in the same position it reverts to its original shortness, as {{GHGheb|text=דְּבַרְכֶם}} (''d<sup>e</sup>bhărkhèm''), &c. In the same way the tone-lengthened ''ā'' or ''ē'' of the second syllable in the ''constr. st.'' sing. also becomes short again, since the ''constr. st.'' resigns the principal tone to the following word, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=דְּבַר אֱלֹהִים}}; {{GHGheb|text=חֲצַר הַבַּ֫יִת}} (from {{GHGheb|text=חָצֵר}}).

{{GHGmargin-letter|92|g}}
Rem. The Masora (cf. ''Diqduqe ha-ṭ<sup>e</sup>amim'', p. 37) reckons thirteen words which retain {{GHGterm|Qameṣ}} in the ''constr. st.'', some of which had originally ''â'' and therefore need not be considered. On the other hand, {{GHGheb|text=אוּלָם}} or {{GHGheb|text=אֻלָם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=7|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=40|verse=48}}, &c. (in spite of the ''constr. st.'' plur. {{GHGheb|text=אֻֽלַמֵּי}}); {{GHGheb|text=מִבְטָח}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=65|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=25|verse=19}}; {{GHGheb|text=מַצָּב}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=13|verse=23}} (so Baer, but ed. Mant., Ginsburg, &c. {{GHGheb|text=מַצַּב}}); {{GHGheb|text=מִשְׁקָל}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ezr|chapter=8|verse=30}} and {{GHGheb|text=מַתָּן}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=18|verse=16}} are very peculiar.

{{GHGmargin-letter|92|h}}
'''3.''' The vowel changes in the inflexion of ''feminine nouns'' (§ 95) are not so considerable, since generally in the formation of the feminine either the original vowels have been retained, or they have already become {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|92|i}}
Besides the vowel changes discussed above in ''a–g'', which take place according to the general formative laws (§§ 25–28), certain further phenomena must also be considered in the inflexion of nouns, an accurate knowledge of which requires in each case an investigation of the original form of the words in question (see §§ 84–86). Such are, e.g., the rejection of the {{GHGheb|text=ה}} of {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} stems before all formative additions (cf. {{GHGpar|91|d}}), the sharpening of the final consonant of {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}} stems in such cases as {{GHGheb|text=חֹק}}, {{GHGheb|text=חֻקִּי}}, &c.

{{GHGmargin-letter|92|k}}
A striking difference between the vowel changes in the verb and noun is that in a verb when terminations are added it is mostly the second of two changeable vowels which becomes {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}} ({{GHGheb|text=קָטַל}}, {{GHGheb|text=קָֽטְלָה}}, {{GHGheb|text=קָֽטְלוּ}}), but in a noun, the first ({{GHGheb|text=דָּבָר}}, {{GHGheb|text=דְּבָרִי}}, {{GHGheb|text=דְּבָרִים}}), cf. § 27. 3.<section end="par92" /><noinclude>
